outgoing.name: Edward III of England
outgoing.excerpt: Through Orleton, Edington’s abilities were brought to the attention of King Edward III, and in 1341 the king named him keeper of the wardrobe.

outgoing.name: Hampshire
outgoing.excerpt: In 1335 Orleton collated him to the rectory of Cheriton, Hampshire, and from 1335 to 1346 he was master of St Cross Hospital in Winchester.

outgoing.name: Hundred Years' War
outgoing.excerpt: The treasury was in great debt from the heavy demands of the early stages of the Hundred Years' War.

outgoing.name: Palace of Westminster
outgoing.excerpt: As a bishop he was necessarily much absent, even with the relatively short distance between Westminster and Winchester.
